cases.setup: Public class-contained overload failure is causally tied to immediate-scope lookup missing a module-level typing.overload import.
checks: Require current owner and provenance discovery before edits.

cases.setup: A supported typing module alias with a simple-name receiver is rejected by receiver spelling membership.
checks: Tie recognition to import provenance rather than alias spelling.

cases.setup: Only a renamed directly imported Literal symptom is supplied; module receiver causality is unknown.
checks: Do not emit applicability-established from the title alone.

cases.setup: An unrelated local decorator named overload appears in ordinary redefinitions.
checks: Do not suppress diagnostics based on spelling.

cases.setup: Lexical recognition works; only singleton decorator scanning is defective.
checks: Reject shared binding-template applicability for this cause.

cases.setup: Another analyzer has similar symptoms without independently supported operations.
checks: Do not claim cross-project applicability or transfer success.
